comment: Mirrors tests/conformance/tsconfig.json (NodeNext + strict). rootDir is '.' and stays '.': the eval package owns its corpus + lib + run.ts and imports no sibling Mandu package STATICALLY. The deterministic backend reaches tests/conformance/lib/harness.js's buildStack via a RUNTIME import() of an absolute file: specifier (the anthropic-proxy/src/server-main.ts cross-package pattern), so tsc never resolves the sibling sources under this rootDir — no '..' rootDir needed. run.ts is the CLI entry.
